content: I recall seeing some thread analyzing quality of the formalizations but it has apparently disappeared ... (I didn't save it)

I find it very odd that the "pinnacle" prize is for formalization of 7 problems which just happen to be the Clay problems, although nowhere does this coincidence seem to be mentioned (maybe I missed it).

On vibes, the website does not inspire confidence.

On the plus side, some data on how they make decisions appears to be public in this repo https://github.com/TheJustinSunPrize/awards
